notes.title: Antiquitas v2.0.0 Released
notes.notes:
Antiquitas has now been bumped up to v2.0.0!  Sorry for the launch issues some have been having lately, but the new build is here and ready to go.  Check out the full release notes here:

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=51287

notes.title: Antiquitas v1.33.0 Released
notes.notes:
Antiquitas has been patched with a roll-up of all engine fixes and improvements from My Colony v1.34-v1.37.  This includes a new music rendering engine that reduces CPU usage, bug fixes for saving very large game saves, a redesign of the in-game menus and more.  

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=50739

notes.title: Antiquitas v1.32.0 Released
notes.notes: Antiquitas has been updated to v1.32.0, bringing minor fixes, as well as improved gamepad controls and support for the Steam Deck.  Enjoy!

notes.title: Antiquitas v1.31.0 Released
notes.notes:
This update fixes a lot of issues and adds the Challenges feature, compete with other players for resource production.  See full notes here:

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=47675

notes.title: Antiquitas v1.30.0 Released
notes.notes: This update fixes a handful of bug and makes some minor improvements to the user interface.

notes.title: Antiquitas v1.29.0 Released
notes.notes:
The v1.29.0 patch for Antiquitas is now available, including various bug fixes and adding jailing/security to various structures.  See the following release notes for more details:

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=40062

notes.title: Antiquitas v1.28.0 Released
notes.notes:
The v1.28.0 patch for Antiquitas is out, and it's an exciting one, because online play has been added to the game!  Now you can join other players empires and trade resources online.  See the full release notes for more info, and stay tuned for more!

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=38835

notes.title: Antiquitas v1.26.0 Released
notes.notes:
Antiquitas v1.26.0 is now available for download!  This update comes with a ton of engine changes and improvements that I think you will enjoy, including worker stacking, the option to move buildings, easier management of Region games, and building production level controls.  See the full release notes at the link below, thank you for playing Antiquitas, and stay tuned for more!

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=35764

notes.title: Antiquitas v1.25.0 Released
notes.notes:
The v1.25.0 patch is here!  This update adds a lot of UI improvements and features.  Check out the link below for full release notes, and stay tuned for more!

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=33456

notes.title: Patch v1.24.0 Released
notes.notes:
Good news, the v1.24.0 patch is here with a whole host of great improvements.  Check out the release notes at the link below, and enjoy the game!

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=31694

notes.title: v1.23.0 Patch Released
notes.notes:
Antiquitas v1.23.0 has just been published and should be ready for your consumption!  This update brings loads of engine improvements, including a vast upgrade of the bulldozer tool.  See the full release notes on ape-apps.com for details, and stay tuned for more.  Enjoy!

Full release notes:
https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=29963

notes.title: v1.22.0 Patch Released
notes.notes:
Greetings Antiquitas players, I have just published the v1.22.0 patch to the game!  This update includes a bunch of engine improvements and bug fixes, and updates a few of the textures.  See the following thread for more info, stay tuned for more, and thank you for playing Antiquitas!

https://www.ape-apps.com/viewpage.php?p=28908

notes.title: v1.21.0 Patch Released
notes.notes:
Happy new year everyone!  The v1.21.0 patch for Antiquitas is now available on Steam.  This patch contains a lot of bug fixes, UI improvements, Region improvements, encyclopedia improvements, and a brand new Alpine winter map.

Thanks for playing everyone!

notes.title: v1.20.0 Patch Released
notes.notes: Today I have released the v1.20.0 patch for Antiquitas!  This one has a lot of bug fixes, some UI upgrades, and a rewrite of the way GDP is calculated.

notes.title: v1.19.0 Patch Uploaded
notes.notes:
I've just uploaded the v1.19.0 patch for Antiquitas!  This update features a handful of bug fixes, and enables LAN/WiFi multiplayer.  If you are playing Antiquitas on the same LAN as another player, you can trade resources between cities.

Thanks for playing, more to come!

notes.title: v1.18.1 Patch Uploaded
notes.notes: Just uploaded the v1.18.1 patch, with a handful of bug fixes.  Keep letting me know if you find any issues!

notes.title: Antiquitas Goes Live on Steam!
notes.notes: Hey everyone, today is the day that Antiquitas goes live on Steam!  Hope you all enjoy it, and tell your friends to download the game as well!
